d:
A timeless symbol of abundance and evolution, the has been interpreted by cultures all over the world. In this episode, we explore its significance through the art of painting.
Images, in order of appearance:
1. The Urartian tree of life, Urartu Helmet fragment/Wikipedia Creative Commons
2. Untitled (Warli), 2019, Amit Mahadev Dhombhare from the Sarmaya collection
3. The Tree of Life, Stoclet Frieze, 1909 by Gustav Klimt from the Museum of Applied Arts, Vienna/Wikipedia Creative Commons
4. Lion and the Snake by Jyoti Karn from the Sarmaya collection
